verdict.rationale: The featurebase-js SDK has a boot / update / shutdown lifecycle, which suggests the in-app widget can be booted with the current user's session, and release notes can be segmented by user attributes, so the product does hold user identity data. Neither item explicitly says that feedback submissions are tied to an existing logged-in account. Missing for 10: explicit docs on identifying users or SSO for feedback submission, a secure identity verification method (e.g. signed user hash or JWT), account or company linking for posts, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
